messages.subject: Ability, Discrimination and difficulty value
parts:
Hi Phil,

Thank You for responding to my previous queries.

I am a newbie and your package has motivated me to work with IRT. I have doubts that I have numbered into three categories. Kindly clarify these.

I am using MIRT by which I created a model as below:

(1) model= mirt(data, model =1, itemtype="graded")
        - what does model=1 imply?
        - Does this give only ability,discrimination and difficulty values

(2) coef(polymodel1)
      - This gives output of each items labeled as a1,....an and d1.

         Please tell me what is a1 and d1.

          I have understood that  a1 is discrimination and d1 is difficulty. Is it correct?

(3) fscores()
   - Does this give the ability estimate of each of the respondent
   - Are negative estimates correct?

Thanks in advance
